description: What is one thing I hold comparable to at a school I am considering? One learning unit of any kind - a course at the school it was taken at, an exam at a score, a learning unit by id, or a certification - compared with any target school, every source asked in turn and each step said as it ran: CourseShelf's published rules held for the target; CourseShelf's inferred landings, read from stored inferred rows when held, else by walking the published links of every kind (a published rule one way; an exam at a shared score, a common course number, or an agreement's or state's course both ways), crossing kinds, up to `depth` links; CourseAtlas's published equivalencies, live; and CourseAtlas's inferred chain (GetIndirectTargets), live. Each step says found, none, not held, error or skipped, with its time in ms. A published rule decides where the unit lands; an inferred landing names its path of published links and is shown as inferred, never as published, withdrawn where a published rule holds. An exam is read by its exam node and judged at the held score. Recognition is the target school's act. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.

courseatlas_depth.description: Optional: CourseAtlas's chain depth, 1 to 3 (default 2, the transfer map's own)

depth.description: Optional: the most published links an inferred path may take, 1 to 3 (default 2)

item.description: One learning unit: a course { unitid, code as printed (e.g. BIOL 100) }, an exam { program (e.g. AP), exam (its code or title), score }, { learning_unit_id }, or { certification_ctid }

target_unitid.description: The school to compare with, any school, by IPEDS UNITID, e.g. 240727

name: comparable_map

exam_node.description: For an exam, the exam node it was read by

lands_as.description: Each published rule, else each inferred landing, with its band; an inferred landing names its path (inferred_through) and the published rows it rests on (inferred_from_ids)

state.description: published | published_below_score | inferred | published_below_score_inferred | none | unresolved

steps.description: Each source as it ran: { step, source, outcome, count, ms, detail }

target.description: The target, with its CourseAtlas identity and the time that read took

title: Comparable Map
